summary: Frontend E2E testing of Staff Login (Slice B) for MARTbakēd Partner MVP. 6 of 7 tests PASS. Renders, happy path (redirect + token), wrong store code, cross-store denial, owner-login CTA, and both Partner Hub CTAs (hero + nav) all work correctly. Only TEST 5 (wrong password = 'wrong') fails because backend Pydantic validation rejects passwords <8 chars with HTTP 422 BEFORE credential check, and the frontend does not map 422 to a friendly toast — user sees a raw axios error 'Request failed with status code 422'. A 12-char wrong password ('wrongpass123') correctly returns 401 and displays 'Invalid credentials' toast, confirming the credential-check path is fine; only the 422 handling is a UX gap.

minor.issue: Password Pydantic min_length validation returns 422 for short passwords such as 'wrong'. From a security-UX perspective this leaks that the password field has a min length. Consider returning a generic 401 'Invalid credentials' for all failed logins regardless of password length, OR reduce/remove min_length constraint on login (only enforce on registration/password-change).

ui_bugs.issue: 422 responses are not mapped to a friendly toast — user sees raw 'Request failed with status code 422' from axios. Should surface backend's detail message or fall back to 'Invalid credentials'.

issues: React hydration warning: <a> descendant of <a> inside OpportunityCard (hub-opportunity-dark-store contains hub-opportunity-dark-store-login). Non-blocking but generates console error.

action_items: Map non-2xx staff-login responses (401, 403, 422) to friendly toast messages in StaffLoginPage.jsx — use error.response.data.detail when present, else 'Invalid credentials'.
Optionally relax password min_length on the staff-login Pydantic model so short wrong passwords also yield 401 'Invalid credentials' (parity with test spec).
Fix nested <a> in PartnerHubApp OpportunityCard (line ~279 vs 302) to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffLoginPage.jsx should have a single error handler that reads err.response?.data?.detail and defaults to 'Invalid credentials' — currently 422 leaks raw axios message.
Consider harmonising all failure statuses to 401 for login endpoints to prevent enumeration/user experience inconsistencies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slice B Staff Login is functionally solid. All success/redirect/token/toast flows work. Only remaining gap is 422 error mapping on frontend + optional backend password min_length relaxation. Backend curl smoke tests already validated by main agent; no backend re-run needed. Hydration warning on /partner nested <a> is pre-existing.
rca of the issue: TEST 5 'wrong password' expected 'Invalid credentials' toast. The staff-login Pydantic request model enforces password min_length (likely 8). When user submits password='wrong' (5 chars), FastAPI returns 422 with validation error BEFORE the credential-check code runs. The frontend catch block does not extract err.response.data.detail for 422, so axios' default message 'Request failed with status code 422' is displayed in the sonner toast. Reproduction: submit any password shorter than backend min_length -> 422 raw toast. Mitigation: (1) in StaffLoginPage handleSubmit, replace generic toast with `toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Invalid credentials')`, or (2) remove min_length from the login Pydantic model so all bad-creds return 401.
